The office does not diverge from the amended criterion 6(g). No new blocking defect. Nine small non-blocking notes (NF1-NF9) at the end; fix them in the same edit if cheap, none needs a new round.

== ROUND-1 FINDINGS, ONE BY ONE ==
F1 RESOLVED (office-report.js). Design: 3.8 l.789-825 (--journal required, --session optional; model built from the whole journal; server-starts.jsonl read from the journal's directory, absent -> []; nowMs = Date.now(); session filter = tasks with that session_id, their routes and main rows, events/trusted/sessions_running by that session; exit 0/1/2; Russian stderr without '    at '; stdout empty on failure; never writes), 8.4 E30a-f l.1616-1628, OF-13 (two sessions, --session, server-starts.jsonl next to the journal, sha256 unchanged) and OF-17a-f l.1990-1999, Q10 row l.2282 now lists OF-17a-f, M36, AP-014 class rule names the file (l.1639), Q12 ruling recorded (2.1 l.477-481, 13.12). My check: I implemented the report path from the text alone (read file, parse+validate, model, office, session filter, JSON) and ran it on a 100,000-line, 18.8 MiB file: 222 ms (read 71, parse 62, model+office 83, report 5); nothing had to be guessed except the two small points in NF7.
F2 RESOLVED (Sim.sync and its test). Design: 2.3 l.572 and 4.5 l.1119-1151 (sync adds missing characters, drops vanished ones with their queue, re-seats only an idle character whose desk changed, never touches a walking or queued one; enqueue(routes,{seen}) ignores seen ids; routes ordered by event_index, handoff before result; `after` makes a result wait for its handoff), accessors App.getOffice/getSim (l.574), OF-18 l.2000, OF-15 via getSim, M33, M39. My check: I wrote the Sim exactly as the text says and ran 300 random journals (150-1,050 lines, 4-26 roles, 1-3 concurrent sessions, nested and foreground launches, polls of 1-40 lines with random ticks between them): 0 runs that fail to drain, 0 characters off their seat after the drain, 0 off-floor samples, 0 busy characters moved by sync, 0 results that started before their handoff ended (44,251 results). The wait-for graph is acyclic by construction (every queue edge and every `after` edge points to a route that was enqueued earlier, a handoff always before its result), so `after` cannot deadlock. On the real P2/P8 payloads the nested foreground pair (9:handoff, 11:result) and the main foreground pair (15, 16) now carry after=handoff id.
F3 RESOLVED (labels vs real roles). Design: roleLabel, LABEL_FONT '9px system-ui', LABEL_MAX_WIDTH 130, fillText with maxWidth (2.3 l.571/573, 3.6 l.761-764, 4.5 l.1172-1186), full name only in legend and card, OF-19 l.2001, M34, D13. My re-measure in Google Chrome 154.0.8037.59 (ctx.measureText) on the 23 real 'name:' values of .claude/agents plus general-purpose, Explore, Plan: old rule at 8 px 17-219 px, 13 of 26 wider than the 144 px desk spacing, 1 wider than 216 px; at 10 px 21-267 px, 19 of 26 and 5 (the design says 18 at 10 px; immaterial). New rule at 9 px: 19-98 px, none wider than 130 or 144, at most 16 code points, all 26 labels distinct (list: BA-ANALYST, BACKEND-DEV, CODE-DESIGN-VAL..., CODE-DESIGNER, ... ORCH, ... general-purpose, Explore, Plan; the design's two examples reproduce). maxWidth 130 squeezes a 448 px text to exactly 130 px (getImageData 135..264) and leaves a short label untouched.
F4 RESOLVED (markup, texts, click, drawing contracts). Design: 4.7 l.1245-1297 (legend items data-role + class legend-item with spans role/count/desk; card with h3.card-title, span.card-working, three section.card-section[data-list] with h4/ul/li, li.empty; texts.js complete: ROLE_UNKNOWN, SHOWN_NOTE, CARD_WORKING, CARD_SESSIONS, CARD_HEADINGS, CARD_EMPTY), 4.5 l.1153-1170 (canvasPoint = (clientX-rect.left)*canvas.width/rect.width; hit box 0.9*CELL x 1.1*CELL around the cell centre; nearest wins, tie -> smaller desk_index) and drawing order (one fillRect(x*CELL,y*CELL,CELL,CELL) per cell with CELL_COLORS[cellKind] before monitors and characters), 2.3 l.570 (DESKS.cell = top-left of the 2x2 block), 3.5 (MainRow.end_index) and 3.7 (recent_completed by end_index), LY-05 l.1969, OF-20 l.2002, fake canvas with getBoundingClientRect and recording fillRect/fillText+maxWidth (10.1). Remaining: one field-name mismatch, NF1.
F5 RESOLVED (plan order, REQ-007 footprint). Design: 14 l.2397-2440 now builds layout and office-* (step 5) before app.js/boot.js/index.html/style.css (step 6) and states why; the REQ-007 row l.2411 names the office parts of app.js, index.html, texts.js, style.css; the eslint block moved to the REQ-001 page row l.2410; ORCH's ruling (these parts count as 'файлы офиса') is accepted, no requirement change. I checked every planned file against handoffs/BP-20260930-01/parallel-runs.jsonl (still 5 lines, PO paths unchanged): all 16 planned paths are inside tools/src/pixel-office/, tools/test/, tools/eslint.config.js, tools/README.md, tools/package.json, .claude/settings.json; tools/src/snapshot.js, tools/src/cli.js and .claude/agents/ are not declared and not planned; the helper file is now named in both write-set lists of the amended requirements (r5) and npm test is still node --test "test/**/*.test.js" (tools/package.json line 19), so it is not run as a test. Cosmetic leftovers in NF4.
F6 RESOLVED (step U3). I extracted the recipe from the design text (10.4 l.2114-2123) and ran it VERBATIM with /bin/bash (GNU bash 3.2.57) on stand-in pages that follow the v2 contracts (index.html with the 4.7 ids, canvas 648x576, module graph boot->app->model/office/layout, 2 s poll, animation loop, data-drawn set only after drawOffice returned, console.error when drawing throws), served by my own server on free ports with the 5.4 CSP and Host check, conditions 1-5 copied from the design: GOOD page: the recipe ends by itself in 1.5 s (exit 0), conditions 1-5 all ok, no Chrome process left. BROKEN OFFICE (an exception inside drawOffice after the task list was rendered, the case the old U3 passed): dump fine, badge and task present, but condition 4 FAILS (no data-drawn) and condition 5 FAILS (console lines 'drawOffice failed: ...'). Classic <script src> without type=module: conditions 2, 3, 4, 5 fail ('Uncaught SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module'). <style> element: condition 5 fails (CSP console line). Closed port: the recipe ends by itself after 31.2 s with 'НЕ ПРОЙДЕНО: дамп DOM не получен за 30 с', conditions 1-4 fail, no Chrome left. A heavy but healthy page (long task at load, slow interval and animation handlers) produced no CONSOLE line, so condition 5 does not give false failures on slow pages. Also in the design: U3 runs between U1(i) and U1(zh) (10.4 l.2045-2047), is mapped in 10.3 to REQ-001 criteria 8 and 9 and REQ-007 criterion 6 (l.2021, 2022, 2038), 'не выполнено' only if Chrome is absent, SV-18 l.1878 and PG-20 l.1944 check no <style> element and type=module on every <script>, OF-21 l.2003, M35. Caveat (NF3): it must be run with bash, not zsh.
N1 RESOLVED Task.stop_indices (3.5 l.724, 4.2 l.911-913, 4.5 l.1108-1109; routes use it, the trust filter is applied once). N2 RESOLVED `after` (3.6 l.757-772, 4.5 l.1119-1126, OF-06/OF-18, M39; verified by the Monte-Carlo above). N10 RESOLVED (4.1 l.885-894 assumption paragraph, README limitation 9 l.1750-1751, P19); I re-measured: with the design's setting (mean interval 15 s) a clock step back of 150 s marks 2 real lines, 600 s 36, 3,600 s 319; on my dense journal 42, 830, 6,158 - same orders of magnitude as the text.

== ALIGNMENT WITH THE AMENDED CRITERION 6(g) ==
The office (4.5 l.1093-1101, OF-05 l.1982) ties the main character to an open main-session row (in_progress); a row closed only by a server start is 'окончание не записано' and is not work, a later Stop makes it 'завершена' and the character still does not work. This agrees with 4.2 l.935-991, 3.5 l.727-733, PG-12d6 and with the requirement text (REQ-001 AC6(g), block hash with status restored 530b1c3b13d58598..., REQ-007 d842c5983085e387..., both recomputed by me and equal to the r5 validator's and to the design's Q1). My checks: (a) the eleven OF-05 main-character scenarios on my prototype of the written rules, all as stated (including: server start BEFORE the request keeps the turn 'в работе'; Stop of another session closes nothing; request, session end, resume, Stop stays 'окончание не записано'; a stale server-start record is ignored); (b) an independent event-driven reading written from the amended criterion text compared with the design's first-event rule on every prefix of 4,000 random journals (two sessions, SessionStart/SessionEnd/resume, untrusted lines, 0-3 server-start records, some stale): 42,180 prefixes, 0 row differences; (c) in all of them the office's main working_count equals the number of rows the criterion text leaves open (0 differences). ORCH's O1 ruling (no clause added to REQ-007 AC2, section 4.5 stands) is consistent with this.

== NEW FINDINGS (none blocking) ==
NF1 [LOW] 3.7 l.776 vs 3.6 l.761-764 and 4.7 l.1270: Card = {key, label, ...} but the card title must show the FULL name (card-title = full) and label is now the short canvas label. Fix: name the Card field full (or say Card.label is the full name).
NF2 [LOW] 4.5 l.1177-1183 and OF-19 l.2001: textAlign and the label's x are not stated. 'крайние не выходят за холст' holds for text centred at the cell centre (540 +- 65 px < 648), not for the canvas default (left alignment at the cell edge: 528+130 = 658). Real labels (<= 98 px) fit either way (measured), so no visible harm. Fix: textAlign = 'center' at x = (x+0.5)*CELL, checked in OF-19.
NF3 [LOW] 10.4 U3 l.2111: the recipe is a bash script, but this tool's shell is zsh and there `set -m` aborts at once (measured: "can't change option: -m", exit 1, no Chrome started); $TMP is also left behind. Fix: 'save to a file and run with /bin/bash file' and rm -rf "$TMP" after the conditions.

NF5 [LOW] OF-10 l.1987: mutant M29 expects OF-10 to fail when a main-thread line with agent_type (a --agent session, hooks doc, common fields) or an untrusted line reaches a role card, but OF-10 does not name that case. Fix: add it to OF-10.
NF6 [LOW] 4.5 l.1128-1136: a route dropped together with a vanished walker (trust flip) leaves a queued `result` of another walker waiting forever if its `after` points to that dropped handoff; the text covers only findPath = null. Fix: a route dropped with its walker counts as finished for `after`, plus one line in OF-18.
NF7 [LOW] 3.8: the `session` key without --session and `main.present` under --session are not defined (for example session: null; present = the session has a trusted line).
NF8 [LOW] 4.5 l.1172-1176: roleLabel for nested or unbalanced parentheses ('foo (a (b))', 'foo (bar') is not stated; my reading keeps the whole name; the 26 real names are unaffected and OF-19 uses only them. Add one sentence and two cases.
